findings.evidence: "The loader only assigns, never `source`s or `eval`s, so quotes, `$` and backticks stay inert ... a double-quoted expansion is never re-parsed, so quotes, `$`, backticks and newlines stay inert" restates generic bash semantics the model already knows.
findings.fix: Keep the NEVER-paste-JSON-into-a-command rule (it corrects a real agent mistake) but trim the two shell-semantics explanations to one clause; the rule needs no bash tutorial.

findings.evidence: "Before touching any exclusion-set variable, ask: is this exclusion permanent (auth, config, real error) or same-wave only (quota)?" is the body's only thinking prompt; every other fork is an exact recipe.
findings.fix: Add one judgment prompt in the same style at the other high-consequence forks — before Step 5's fold block (final review actually passed, FOLD_BASE the commit before Task 1) and before an owner stop — so the thinking pattern generalizes beyond Step 2.

findings.evidence: "Never switch harness, provider or model after a failed or unusable run." cites ai-kit-cross-ai sections 6 and 8 for its why instead of stating it inline, unlike the other NEVER items.
findings.fix: Add one inline reason clause (a switch after a failure spends a second budget on an unverified candidate, and the runner already walked its ladder inside the one call) and keep the cross-ai pointer for the full rule.

findings.evidence: "act on it as ../../ai-kit-session-wake/SKILL.md says under 'When arm prints a companion time'" chains SKILL.md to a reference to another skill's SKILL.md, beyond the spec's one-level-deep file-reference convention (the target resolves and the load condition is explicit, so this is polish).
findings.fix: Name the exact sibling path and section once in this file with the same do-not-load-the-rest gate it already has, keeping reference chains flat; the path itself is correct as written.

findings.evidence: "Compose the prompt from subagent-driven-development's implementer-prompt.md template ... into $PROMPT_FILE" leaves the byte-exact objective (the text the lane's task digest hashes) composed with medium freedom from a template held only in another skill's loaded copy.
findings.fix: Pin the fragile part harder: quote the objective-opening and WRITE/APPEND sentences verbatim here (as references/quota-wake.md already does for the wake prompt), or add a one-line self-check on $PROMPT_FILE before the first dispatch, so a template rendered from memory cannot drift on the task digest.

findings.evidence: "$RUN_DIR/gates.txt: the project's gate commands, one per line, from its instruction file (its unit and arch gate lines)" names no path or detection rule for the instruction file, leaving the gates source ambiguous on a first run.
findings.fix: Name where the instruction file is found — the project's AGENTS.md or the curated-config location the config-check block already reads — or give a detection rule, so the agent locates the gate lines without guessing.
